settings.text: Everything you need to know before you sow.
If your question is not answered here, our team is happy to help with variety choices, growing conditions, or anything about your order. Email support@pixiseeds.com and we will get back to you.

settings.title: How do I choose the right seeds for my climate?
settings.content: Every product page lists ideal growing zones and seasons. When in doubt, start with varieties labeled for your region or contact us for a quick recommendation.

settings.title: How should I store my seeds?
settings.content: Keep them cool, dry, and away from light. A sealed jar in the refrigerator extends viability for many seasons.

settings.title: Do you ship internationally?
settings.content: We currently ship within the regions listed at checkout. If your country is not available, join our list — we expand routes regularly.

settings.title: What is your return policy?
settings.content: Unopened items in original packaging may be returned within 14 days. Seed packets are final sale once opened for quality assurance.

settings.title: Do you guarantee germination?
settings.content: Our seeds are selected and tested for viability, but germination depends on soil, water, temperature, and care after they leave us, so results cannot be guaranteed. If a packet arrives damaged or incorrect, contact us within 14 days and we will put it right.
